verdicts.reason: Ἄβελ is a low-risk proper-name identity; Luke 11:51 has one exact genitive token and the Korean candidate 아벨 preserves identity without semantic expansion.
Ἀβιά is a proper-name identity in Luke 1:5; 아비야 is source-faithful. OT-person mapping remains provenance rather than an added lexical sense.
Ἀβιληνή is a place name in Luke 3:1. 아빌레네/아빌레네 지방 is acceptable as identity plus geographic-type clarification, not a new lexical sense.
Ἀβραάμ is consistently the proper name 아브라함 across 15 exact Luke tokens and five observed case morphologies; morphology does not alter identity.
TBESG/TFLSJ and Luke 8:31 support abyss/deep. 무저갱/깊은 곳 is appropriate; do not collapse the term into a later systematic concept of 지옥 or claim more than the Luke context supports.
Luke 6:9, 6:33, 6:35 and the pinned lexical boundary support 선을 행하다/좋은 일을 하다. 남에게 선을 베풀다는 contextual paraphrase only and should not replace the core verbal sense.

ἀγαθός has 16 exact Luke tokens across adjectival and substantival morphologies and spans good/ethical, beneficial, and good-things/property contexts. The candidate list is directionally sound but promotion should wait for an explicit context-to-sense partition so 좋은/선한/유익한/좋은 것·재물 are not flattened into interchangeable glosses.
Luke 1:14 and 1:44 plus TBESG/TFLSJ support strong/exuberant joy. 크게 기뻐함/환희/넘치는 기쁨 preserves the nuance; generic 기쁨 alone would understate the boundary.
